name: Creavi Appointment Booking Calendar
author: Creavi

sections.description:
Creavi is a free WordPress appointment booking plugin for service businesses. Let customers choose a service, select a specialist, and book an available time on your website. Google Calendar and Outlook sync, built-in secure video conferencing, email reminders, shared staff schedules, and booking approval are included, with no plugin-imposed service or booking limits.

Use a booking button, an embedded calendar, or a Service Catalog with categories and provider selection. Suitable for salons, clinics, consultants, coaches, personal trainers, fitness studios, and yoga instructors.

Try the live booking demo | Read the documentation | Ask a support question

Give customers a clear way to book

  • Show services as a simple list or organise them into categories, with optional images and your own labels.
  • Let customers select a provider and see available times that fit the service duration.
  • Place a calendar directly on a page or open it from a booking button. Both layouts work on mobile.
  • Match your site with colour, layout, wording, and calendar-language controls beside a live preview.

Keep staff schedules and connected calendars aligned

  • Link several services to one staff calendar. A booking blocks overlapping times across those services.
  • Connect Google Calendar or Outlook to create appointment events and block connected-calendar busy times.
  • Set weekday hours, days off, minimum notice, and rolling booking windows in days or months.
  • Choose 10, 15, 20, 30, 60, or 90-minute appointments and optional 5–60 minute buffers.
  • Use visitor-local or business timezones, with 12 or 24-hour display.

Manage appointments from WordPress

  • Confirm bookings automatically or review requests before approval, separately for each service.
  • Approve or reject pending requests from the booking list or individual booking screen.
  • Review rescheduling or cancellation of upcoming appointments and choose customer notifications.
  • Send editable customer and admin emails, separate reminders, and calendar attachments.
  • Collect contact details, custom answers, and consent with configurable forms.
  • Export selected bookings to CSV or Excel, and choose an optional retention period for old records.

Start with an editable Elementor demo page

Choose from nine demo pages for salons, yoga studios, dental clinics, consultants, coaches, and sales demos, including the Instagram Brand Consultant design.

Imports create draft pages with images, services, and catalogs. Set real content and availability before publishing. Demo pages require Elementor V4 atomic elements and global classes. Regular shortcodes work without Elementor. More demos are coming soon.

Add booking to your existing website

  • Inline calendar: [creavibc_booking_inline id="123"]
  • Popup booking button: [creavibc_booking_button id="123"]
  • Service Catalog: [creavibc_service_catalog id="123"]

Replace 123 with the service or catalog ID. Shortcodes work with the block editor, Elementor, and other builders. Booking Profile and Service Hero blocks are also included.

Offer in-person, phone, or online appointments with your own meeting link or a generated video meeting.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin in WordPress.
  2. Open Creavi Booking → All Services. Add a service, availability, form fields, and approval preference.
  3. Add its shortcode to a page, or create a Service Catalog for multiple services.
  4. Optionally connect calendars, configure reminders, or import an Elementor demo page.
  5. Preview the page and make a test booking.
sections.faq:
Is Creavi appointment booking free?

Yes. Calendar connections, staff schedules, reminders, approval, exports, and demos are included. There are no plugin-imposed service or booking limits; capacity depends on your hosting. Website, email, and calendar providers remain separate services.

Does it sync with Google Calendar and Outlook?

Yes. Connected calendars can receive booking events and block busy times. Google and Outlook sync is included without a separate Creavi calendar-sync subscription.

Can one staff member offer several services without double bookings?

Yes. Connect those services to the same staff calendar. Its shared availability, existing appointments, and buffer settings are used across the linked services to prevent overlaps.

Do I need Elementor to use the plugin?

No. Booking buttons, inline calendars, and Service Catalog shortcodes work without Elementor. The nine imported demo page designs require Elementor with V4 atomic elements and global classes enabled.

Can I approve, reschedule, or cancel bookings?

Yes. Manual approval lets you review requests while their slots stay reserved. Approve or reject pending requests, or reschedule and cancel upcoming confirmed appointments with optional customer notifications.

Can customers book in their own timezone?

Yes. Choose visitor-local or fixed business timezones, with 12 or 24-hour display. Calendars support the website language and 67 regional choices. Labels are editable per service.

Can I customise the booking form and emails?

Yes. Edit contact, consent, and custom fields, including number and date questions. Customer and admin email templates support placeholders such as {name}, {service}, {date}, and {time}.

Are automated appointment reminders included?

Yes. Customer and admin reminders have separate schedules and templates. They use WordPress mail and scheduled tasks; quiet sites should use regular server-triggered WordPress Cron for timely reminders.

Does Creavi collect online payments?

Creavi’s booking flow schedules appointments; it does not include a built-in payment gateway or checkout.

Can I connect an AI assistant?

Yes, through optional restricted REST API and MCP connections. The native owner MCP connection requires WordPress 6.9 or later and the official MCP Adapter 0.6.1 or later. Customer booking requires HTTPS, selected public services, and a supported AI host.
sections.changelog:
1.8.0

  • Added nine draft Elementor demo pages with images and booking content, including Instagram Brand Consultant. Requires V4 atomic elements and global classes.
  • Added per-service approval, booking-screen action buttons, reviewed rescheduling and cancellation, notifications, and change history.
  • Refined inline and popup calendars with expandable slots, thin scrollbars, soft fades, stable spacing, and improved live previews.
  • Recheck availability before approval, prevent duplicate confirmations, and flag failed calendar-event delivery. Existing shortcodes and settings remain supported.
  • Clarified demo labels and admin news button styling.

Full release notes, including the published 1.7.0 entry, are preserved in changelog.txt in the plugin download.
